Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 의뢰에서 성과를 낸 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 돌아가는 길에 밥을 먹자고 제안한다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: After a successful quest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> suggested grabbing a meal on the way back.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼で成果を出した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、帰り道でご飯を食べようと提案する。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 在委托中取得成果的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>提议回去的路上一起吃个饭。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 在委託中取得成果的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>提議回去的路上一起吃個飯。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Après une mission réussie, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> propose d'aller manger sur le chemin du retour.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nach einer erfolgreichen Mission schlägt <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vor, auf dem Rückweg etwas zu essen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Después de una misión exitosa, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> sugirió ir a comer algo de camino de vuelta.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Após uma missão bem-sucedida, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> sugere comer algo no caminho de volta.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ผู้ประสบความสำเร็จในภารกิจ ได้ชวนไปกินข้าวระหว่างทางกลับ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah berhasil menyelesaikan misi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mengajak makan dalam perjalanan pulang.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã đạt được thành quả trong nhiệm vụ và đề nghị đi ăn trên đường về.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: एक सफल खोज के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने वापसी में भोजन करने का सुझाव दिया।
